hawkins-1991-quiet.citation: Hawkins, May, Pickett and Abell (1991), Benefits of NOAA-11 Channel #3 in Detection of Mesoscale Eddies in the Gulf of Mexico During Summer, pp. 356–360, in Proceedings: Eleventh Annual Gulf of Mexico Information Transfer Meeting, November 1990. OCS Study MMS 91-0040, published October 1991.
hawkins-1991-quiet.access: Original proceedings PDF acquired; actual PDF pages 345–347 / printed pages 356–358 reviewed. Authors explicitly identify Quiet in the same discussion. The dimensions are printed source approximations from August 12 and 19 imagery, not OSW graph or map readings.

records.case_label: Quiet Eddy, August 1990 source SST interpretation
records.period_label: 1990-08-12 and 1990-08-19 source images; dimensions not assigned separately to each image
records.source_locator: Hawkins et al., printed page 358 / PDF page 347, August imagery paragraph and Quiet identification; methods on printed pages 356–357.
records.definition: Source-described north-oriented major axis, nearly 400 km.
records.scope: Individual named Quiet source case during August 1990 separation. Registry physical identity crosswalk and differing separation conventions remain unverified.
records.qualification: Approximate SST expression interpreted from multi-channel AVHRR imagery, with drifting-buoy context. Source discusses an approximately 0.5 degree Celsius edge contrast, not a prescribed closed isotherm. No exact per-image dimensions, fitted ellipse, physical outer boundary or quantified measurement uncertainty established. The two image dates are not a continuous observation window or seasonal minimum/maximum. Nearly 400 km is not a strict bound. No diameter, ellipse area, geometry, lifetime, state containment, ranking or seasonal playback derived.
